personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK surfaces
personality_one_liner: A deeply cinematic, minimal, and premium financial command center combining Apple Wallet's frosted elegance with Notion's fast, clean utility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards must never be flush to screen edges (always md/lg margin). Empty space is intentional, use strict alignment.

do's: Bottom tab bar over scrolling content
Featured Wallet cards with photo backdrops
dont's: Anywhere text underneath becomes legible instead of abstract

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: A commanding snapshot of net worth, cash flow, recent transactions, and quick action buttons.

states.loading: Skeleton UI matching the glass/luxe card dimensions.
states.empty: A clean empty state with 'No transactions yet' and a prominent 'Add Transaction' button.
states.error: Soft error toast with a 'Retry' button in the center.

screens.layout: Use a cinematic hero section (Glassmorphism over a subtle gradient) for the Total Net Worth and Cash flow summary. Below the hero, use horizontally scrolling chips (Income/Expense/Transfer) for the transaction list. Keep the primary CTA (Add Transaction) floating and sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Wallets
screens.purpose: Apple Wallet style stacked cards representing Cash, Bank, Credit Card, and E-wallets.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty wallet with 'Add your first account' CTA.
states.error: Error message with an option to refresh account connections.

screens.layout: Visually replicate Apple Wallet. Use heavy corner radii (lg), overlapping card layout with subtle top shadows to show depth. Each card should feature a distinct subtle tinted gradient or a blurred noise texture to differentiate accounts. Tapping a card expands it.

screens.name: Plan
screens.purpose: Track budgets, saving goals, and structured life events (Wedding, House, Car, Vacation).

states.empty: A serene, minimalist scene with a button to 'Create your first plan'.

screens.layout: Grid-based modular layout. Top section uses progress rings for monthly category budgets. The lower section features large, image-led hero cards for life goals (e.g., a dark sleek car for the Car Planner, minimal architecture for the House Planner) utilizing a gradient-to-dark scrim so text is readable.

screens.name: AI Coach
screens.purpose: Claude-powered chat interface providing personalized financial advice.

states.empty: Suggested starting prompts in minimal pill buttons.

screens.layout: Clean, minimal chat interface akin to Linear/Notion. Bubble-less or very subtle surfaceTertiary bubbles for the AI, and brandPrimary for the user. Sticky text input at the bottom.

wedding_planner_hero.alt: Minimalistic dark aesthetic woman in white dress

car_planner_hero.alt: Sleek dark luxury car side profile

vacation_planner_hero.alt: Minimalist aerial beach and green palms

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color guidelines. Indigo, Violet, Purple, and all forms of Blue are strictly banned. Use the provided Emerald/Moss green accent against the deep charcoal/black base.

Emphasize the 'Glass / Luxe DARK' and 'iOS-Native Clean' hybrid aesthetic. Ensure that frosted glass elements are overlaid correctly over scrolling content or images, applying the gradient scrim pattern required for image text readability.
Implement the 'Apple Wallet' layout accurately in the Wallets tab: stack cards elegantly with generous lg radii.

For typography, use Space Grotesk for primary balances, numbers, and key display elements. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for the remainder of the UI labels, buttons, and body text. Do not bold fonts past weight 500.
Ensure safe area is respected on all screen roots, and touch targets are a minimum of 44x44pt.
Apply the required loading, empty, and error states for each screen.
Use Phosphor icons with consistent weights.
